title: Aye Hussian Mere Jaan
body:
Tere Gham Mein Sada Roega Ye Jahan
Aye Hussian Mere Jaan
Saath Hai Tere Maa Aye Hussain Mere Jaan
Tu Jab Chala Madine Se Dil Mera Phat Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Viran Madina Hogaya Sunsan Ghar Huwa
Yasrab Me Tere Nana Ka Roza Udas Hai
Sugra Mariza Gham Se Tere Be-Hawas Hai
Manzil Yahi Hai Aqri Tayra-o-Qafila
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Nainava Hai Mariya Hai Ye Hai Karbala
Phathar jigar bhi roege roega Aasma
Gardan Pa Teer Khayega Jo Tera Bezuba
Dena hai Mere Laal Tujhe Sakhth Imtehan
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Ke Zaqmi Seene Se Khaichenga Tu Sina
Thandi Hawaye Chalti Hai Darya Bhi Pass Hai Lekin Tere Naseeb Me Aye Laal Pyase Hai
Mazhar Ye Bain Karti Thi Ro-Ro Ke Fatima
Agosh Me Hamare Katenga tera Gala
